gloss: and, moreover, at the same time

definitions.explanation: A formal conjunction connecting two qualities, states, or actions that coexist. Indicates that both conditions hold simultaneously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧かつ⟦{迅速|じんそく}→迅速：14294_jinsoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧かつ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧な⟦{住|す}まい→住まい：11555_sumai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧かつ{低価格|ていかかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This product achieves both high quality and low price.

notes:
A formal literary conjunction that connects two parallel elements, emphasizing that both apply simultaneously. Written in hiragana (かつ) or sometimes in kanji ({且|か}つ). Used primarily in written language, speeches, and formal contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A かつ B: A and B (where A and B are parallel adjectives, nouns, or phrases)
- ⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧かつ⟦{明瞭|めいりょう}→明瞭：20647_meiryou⟧: concise and clear
- ⟦{合理的|ごうりてき}→合理的：06199_gouriteki⟧かつ⟦{効率的|こうりつてき}→効率的：06240_kouritsuteki⟧: rational and efficient
- ⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧かつ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧: calm and bold

USAGE:
かつ typically connects words of similar grammatical type (two な-adjectives, two nouns, etc.). It is more formal than the simple て-form connection or し. In everyday speech, ⟦そして→そして：00997_soshite⟧ or て-form would be used instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦そして→そして：00997_soshite⟧: and, and then — general-purpose, conversational
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: also, moreover — adds information sequentially
- ⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the same time — explicitly states simultaneity
